PASS — #288 at 2a38673f47d08acf6ecba8c7ad06a1000ab980af, base bc1ca834aa1163f86780f77bd83036f3b6b4e6ef. No blocking correctness findings. Review checkout content is unchanged; reviewer holding remains until merge.

Guard review:
- nice19.sh refuses a failed ps or unreadable integer with exit 1, no wrapped command, and an explicit diagnostic. Padded and negative values, argv preservation, and inherited niceness 19/20 pass. The existing normal-path arithmetic and exec are unchanged.
- release-build's pathspec covers the six production include_str hook scripts in claude_settings.rs, schema inputs in community/layout.rs, and role templates in community/templates.rs. All six hook edits, schema/template edits, and an untracked template refuse before cargo. A clean fixture and unrelated model/script edits build normally.
- The release EXIT trap cleans only the uniquely allocated, owned snapshot. Parent-only HUP/INT/TERM leave it present while the foreground shared-build is running, then remove it after that build returns, with exits 129/130/143 and no success path on stdout. Cargo failure preserves 101; a foreign stamp refuses with 1. Another snapshot and an already handed-on copy survive. The successful path clears ownership before printing the copy. This handoff guard is a one-directional safety interlock (brake), not an age/retention policy.
- lock_attach creates the file with private permissions at the open boundary and narrows an existing wide file through its descriptor. A probe holding the wide file's flock while another open narrows it observes the same inode, mode 0600, and WouldBlock: the existing holder's exclusion is not lost. The production lock tests also pass on macOS.
- Hermetic git settings are confined to release/shared-build test fixtures and their child environments. Isolated hostile global/system configuration is ignored with those settings and becomes visible when each exclusion is removed. Production scripts retain their caller's git environment.
- The no-pattern-kill rule is documentation-only. Every signal used by this review targeted a process it started; no other seat's process or lock was touched.

Mutation proof: 15 guard mutants caught. The dependency-free shell/git probes pass 51 checks, including 12 mutants: ps exit status, readable integer, three signal handlers, three embedded-input groups, EXIT cleanup, successful handoff, and both git configuration exclusions. A std-only fixture copied the exact lock_attach/error implementation and passes three baseline checks plus three expected-failing mutants: remove creation mode, remove narrowing, or replace the held inode. The creation-mode assertion observes the descriptor before later chmod could hide an unsafe initial mode. This is isolated fixture proof, not a claim that the TS suite ran locally.

Validation:
- just pr-freeze 288: FINAL immediately before publication; requested head matches both gh and ls-remote, base main, CLEAN, all current checks successful, not draft, migration/Delivers checks satisfied.
- One nice-only, four-job batch through just shared-build and the canonical cargo-target.sh target: cargo test --locked -p pij-tmux --lib attach_lock passed 5/5; cargo clippy --locked -p pij-tmux --all-targets -- -D warnings passed; the isolated std-only lock fixture passed 6/6, including its three expected-failing guard mutants.
- /bin/sh -n harness/scripts/nice19.sh and /bin/bash -n harness/scripts/release-build.sh passed. git diff --check bc1ca834..HEAD passed; checkout remains clean.
- Exact-head CI run 44720859714: check (22), job 136238448733, passed nice19.test.ts 11 tests, release-build.test.ts 6 tests, shared-build.test.ts 23 tests; total TS suite 2375 passed, 7 skipped. check (24), rust-lint, and the successful rust-test rerun are also green at this head.
- Local harness boot reported ready:false because node_modules is absent. harness checks --quick exited 1: missing local tsx/packages and incompatible ambient Biome, not a green gate. No dependency install or symlink was used (C25); TS suite proof is CI-only. Full local workspace/smoke checks were not rerun. The local kernel-lock probes start no tmux fixture server; F237 was not reproduced or treated as this PR's finding.

Cost inventory: no new loop, timer, sweep, or per-seat launch. nice19 remains one /bin/ps per wrapper invocation; the new validation uses shell builtins. Failure/signal snapshot cleanup is one rm for an owned directory, none after successful handoff or refusal before allocation. Attach permissions use in-process metadata/chmod syscalls on an existing attach attempt; attach cadence and scaling are unchanged. This is the functional review's static inventory, not a substitute for the separately owned performance verdict.

Nonblocking harness feedback: the highest-value small improvement is to extend the existing release-build signal test with the verified pre-return snapshot assertion and HUP/INT/TERM table, rather than adding a new mutation framework. Session friction was dependency-free gate unavailability and the first shared-build lock acquisition timing out; the same-target retry succeeded. These observations and receipts are retained for the PM's governance retrospective/disposition.
